thread_analysis.thread_summary: An internal Allion thread (Yu Hong, Denver Mishima, Itsuo Sakai, Toshitaka Mochizuki, Kenichi Ushiroebisu) coordinating RF PHY testing for an Alinco XE1177 DUT, covering USB cable/PC connection troubleshooting (similar to patterns documented in other Alinco threads) and a Class 1 vs. Class 2 Output Power shortfall investigation centered on the BlueTest3 tester's default internal configuration setting.
all_questions_found: Could the test tool's default output power configuration be masking the product's true Class 1 capability? (see thread_0016_case_01)
thread_analysis.key_technical_discussion: The USB cable/PC connection troubleshooting (changing cables, preferring Windows 10 PCs) mirrors patterns already documented in other Alinco-related threads; the new contribution here is investigating whether the tester's default 'Int=50' configuration, rather than a genuine hardware limitation, explains a Class 2-level (rather than Class 1) Output Power test result.
thread_analysis.consulting_takeaway: When a Power Class test result falls short of the target class, check the test tool's default configuration against the product's actual firmware setting before concluding a hardware-level limitation exists.
